function.name: read
function.description: Read a text file as numbered lines. Use offset/limit for large files or to continue capped output.

file_path.description: Path to the text file to read.
file_path.title: File Path

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from; omit to start at line 1.
offset.title: Offset

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read; omit to read until the output budget is reached.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: manage
function.description: Create empty files or directories; create an empty file or directory, delete files or directories, or move/rename paths. No file content is written; use write to add file content.

op.description: File or directory lifecycle operation: create, delete, or move/rename.
op.title: Op

kind.description: Whether the operation targets a file or directory.
kind.title: Kind

paths.description: File or directory path(s); paths is required for op=create and op=delete. Ignored for op=move.
paths.title: Paths

moves.description: Move mappings required for op=move; each item has src, dest, and per-move overwrite. Ignored for op=create/op=delete.
moves.title: Moves

src.description: Source file or directory path for a move operation.
src.title: Src

dest.description: Destination file or directory path for a move operation.
dest.title: Dest

overwrite.description: Whether this move may replace an existing destination file or directory.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

overwrite.description: For op=create only: replace an existing file after safety checks. Ignored for directory create, delete, and move.
overwrite.title: Overwrite

function.name: write
function.description: Edit text files: write op="insert" before a 1-based line, op="append" at EOF, or op="write" creates or fully overwrites full content.

file_path.description: Path to the target text file.
file_path.title: File Path

op.description: Write mode: insert before a 1-based line number, append to an existing file, or write complete file content.
op.title: Op

lineno.description: For op=insert, 1-based line number to insert before. Ignored for op=append and op=write.
lineno.title: Lineno

new_string.description: Text to insert or append; for op=write, complete file content. For op=insert, up to three non-empty leading and trailing lines that exactly match adjacent file lines are treated as overlap rather than duplicated.
new_string.title: New String

function.name: replace
function.description: Replace complete lines in an existing text file. Read the target lines first. Use one bound for one line or two bounds for an inclusive line range; order is ignored. Each bound has a 1-based line_no hint and a case-sensitive anchor from that line. missing or ambiguous anchors fail without modifying the file. new_string is the full replacement for only the resolved line(s).

file_path.description: Path to the existing target text file.
file_path.title: File Path

bounds.description: One or two boundary locators. One locator replaces that resolved line; two locators replace the inclusive range between resolved boundaries. Length must be 1 or 2.

line_no.description: 1-based line number hint from the latest read.
line_no.title: Line No

anchor.description: Literal, case-sensitive substring expected on the boundary line. Required for range replacements; empty only for intentional exact-line single-line replacement.
anchor.title: Anchor

bounds.title: Bounds

new_string.description: Complete replacement text for the resolved line(s). May contain multiple lines; do not include unchanged surrounding lines. Empty string deletes the resolved line(s).
new_string.title: New String

function.name: git
function.description: Run path-scoped git commands. Pass only the git subcommand in args. Core read-only commands return structured JSON; other allowed commands return raw stdout/stderr inside JSON. Write commands require approval; destructive commands are denied.

path.description: Repository working directory. Relative paths resolve from the workspace; empty uses the workspace root.
path.title: Path

args.description: raw git subcommand and arguments only. Do not include git itself; do not include the git executable, e.g. "status --porcelain" or "log --oneline -5".
args.title: Args

function.name: find
function.description: Find files by filename substring and extension filters with stable structured results.

path.description: File or directory scope; defaults to workspace root.
path.title: Path

function.name: search
function.description: Search text with literal, word, or regex matching and structured results.

query.description: Text or regular expression to search for.
query.title: Query

path.description: File or directory scope; defaults to workspace root.
path.title: Path

function.name: lsp
function.description: Run language-server operations: diagnostics, definition lookup, references, and document symbols.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file. Required for all operations except diagnostics (when omitted, returns cached diagnostics for opened files).
file_path.title: File Path

line.description: 1-based line number. Required for definition and references operations.
line.title: Line

character.description: 0-based character offset. Required for definition and references operations.
character.title: Character

include_declaration.description: For references only: include the symbol declaration in results.
include_declaration.title: Include Declaration

function.name: lsp_format
function.description: Format an explicit range in a file with its configured language server and write the result safely.

file_path.description: File to format with the configured language server.
file_path.title: File Path

function.name: clarify
function.description: Ask the user one question when intent, scope, or requirements are ambiguous and explicit input is needed before proceeding. Do not use for progress updates. Later tool calls in the same response are deferred until the answer updates runtime state.

question.description: One specific clarifying question to ask the user.
question.title: Question

options.description: Suggested mutually exclusive answers; leave empty for an open-ended question.
options.title: Options

function.name: checkpoint
function.description: Present a concrete implementation plan as an approval gate before file edits, write-capable commands, or delegated implementation. no code changes occur in this tool. The user can approve, request a design document first, modify scope, or reject. Later tool calls in the same response are deferred until the decision updates runtime state.

goal.description: Stable overall objective for the current task. Keep it short, sharp, and clear.
goal.title: Goal

steps.description: Ordered implementation steps; each step should be one small action.
steps.title: Steps

affected_files.description: Files that may be created, modified, moved, or deleted by the plan.
affected_files.title: Affected Files

risks.description: Risks, edge cases, or trade-offs the user should approve.
risks.title: Risks

function.name: workflow
function.description: Manage workflow node lifecycle. Enter a workflow before gated work, advance after its gate is satisfied, and use done only to close active nodes without activating successors.

workflow.description: Workflow node name. Required for 'enter'. For 'advance'/'done', auto-resolved when only one active node exists.
workflow.title: Workflow

condition.description: Exit condition for 'advance'. Must match an outgoing edge condition in the workflow DAG (case-insensitive). Ignored for 'enter' and 'done'.
condition.title: Condition

goal.description: Stable overall objective for the current task. Keep it short, sharp, and clear. Required for 'enter'. Optional retarget for 'advance'. Ignored for 'done'.
goal.title: Goal

function.name: compact
function.description: Submit a structured summary for older conversation context when VOIDX_COMPACTION_GUIDE is present. This updates runtime memory and removes older live messages; it does not answer the user.

summary.description: Structured Markdown summary of the older context to preserve. Keep durable facts, decisions, constraints, progress, blockers, verification results, and relevant files.
summary.title: Summary

tail_anchor_id.description: Optional id of the first live message that should remain after compaction. Use the tail_anchor_id shown in VOIDX_COMPACTION_GUIDE.
tail_anchor_id.title: Tail Anchor Id

function.name: document
function.description: Read built-in documents only. action="list" reads a directory README index; action="read" loads a specific Markdown document. This tool does not read workspace files, generate documents, or search external sources. Start with action="list" when unsure what exists.

action.description: Document action: list reads a directory README index; read loads a Markdown document.
action.title: Action

path.description: POSIX-style relative path under the built-in document root; omit for the root index.
path.title: Path

function.name: goal_init
function.description: Submit the approved Goal specification during intake or idle shaping.

objective.description: Objective sentence for the autonomous Goal.
objective.title: Objective

function.name: goal_checkpoint
function.description: Persist a structured checkpoint for the current Goal work attempt.

summary.description: Concise summary of the work attempt.
summary.title: Summary

changed_files.description: Files changed by the work attempt.
changed_files.title: Changed Files

function.name: goal_decision
function.description: Persist the evaluator's lifecycle decision for the current Goal attempt.

function.name: loop
function.description: Runtime-backed /loop lifecycle control. The loop only ends when the user runs /loop stop or closes voidx — never end or pause it yourself. Call operation='start' with goal at iteration start. Call operation='commit' with outcome='continue' and a summary to submit the iteration decision and schedule the next wakeup — use it even when this iteration's work is done or you are waiting on something.

operation.description: start declares the iteration goal; commit submits the iteration decision (requires outcome/summary); init submits a LoopSpec for user approval (idle phase only, requires prompt).
operation.title: Operation

prompt.description: For operation=init: the loop prompt/goal. Required for init.
prompt.title: Prompt

interval_seconds.description: For operation=init: fixed interval in seconds. Omit for dynamic mode.
interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds

outcome.description: Iteration outcome. Required for operation=commit; the only valid value is 'continue', which schedules the next wakeup. The loop only ends when the user stops it, so finishing this iteration's work is NOT a reason to end the loop.
outcome.title: Outcome

summary.description: Concise durable summary of this loop iteration.
summary.title: Summary

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a Bash command; working directory is the workspace root. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

command.description: non-interactive Bash command string to execute.
command.title: Command

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds; the process is terminated if exceeded.
timeout.title: Timeout

function.name: todo
function.description: Track multi-step work with a short task list. Use write to replace the list, Use update to move items between pending/active/done, and use read to inspect current progress.

todos.description: Full todo list — required for 'write' operation.
todos.title: Todos

id.description: Semantic id for the todo item (e.g., 'schema', 'api').
id.title: Id

updates.description: List of updates — required for 'update' operation.
updates.title: Updates

content.description: Optional: update description too. Omit or pass empty string to keep existing content.
content.title: Content

filter.description: Filter for 'read' operation: all, pending, active, done.
filter.title: Filter

function.name: skill
function.description: Load skill instructions, create a new SKILL.md, or list discovered skills. Load/list are read-only; create writes a SKILL.md file.

op.description: Operation: 'load' (fetch a skill's instructions), 'create' (write a new SKILL.md), 'list' (enumerate discovered skills).
op.title: Op

name.description: Skill name. Required for op=load and op=create. Lowercase, hyphen-separated (e.g. 'react-patterns').
name.title: Name

body.description: Markdown instruction body. Required for op=create.
body.title: Body

scope.description: Write scope for op=create: project writes .voidx/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; global writes ~/.voidx/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.
scope.title: Scope

function.name: webfetch
function.description: Fetch content from a URL and convert to readable text.

prompt.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content
prompt.title: Prompt

function.name: websearch
function.description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.

allowed_domains.description: Only include search results from these domains
allowed_domains.title: Allowed Domains

blocked_domains.description: Never include search results from these domains
blocked_domains.title: Blocked Domains

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return
max_results.title: Max Results

function.name: mcp
function.description:
Discover and use Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through a stable gateway.

- `mcp(op="list")` returns semantic server summaries; it does not load tool documentation.
- When a server is relevant, use `mcp(op="load", server="...")` before calling it.
- `mcp(op="load")` may target a whole server or one tool and returns current-turn context.
- `mcp(op="call", ...)` executes a real MCP tool; pass arguments as a JSON object.
- Never invent server names, tool names, or parameters; list or load when uncertain.

op.description: Operation: 'list' (discover MCP servers and tool bundles), 'load' (fetch parameter details for a server or tool), 'call' (execute a real MCP tool).
op.title: Op

server.description: MCP server name. Required for op=load and op=call.
server.title: Server

tool.description: MCP tool name. Required for op=call; optional for op=load.
tool.title: Tool

arguments.description: Tool arguments for op=call. Pass a JSON object, not a serialized JSON string.
arguments.title: Arguments
